items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Reverend King and the civil rights march was definitely the motivating force behind the National Baptist Council...

ctx.x: That’s why they shot Reverend King, because he did that. They love it if you hate them. Then they can kill you. Look at the Black Panthers. They were going to fight back. In two months, 30 of them were dead. Love is the strongest force in the universe.
I tell you. That is very evident for me in your lyrics. There are just so many different songs where love is the key word and the key feeling, the philosophy in those lyrics.
